origin.description: Box plot of a numeric response against a factor.
origin.details: When the right-hand side is a factor and the left-hand side is numeric, the boxes are vertical. The x limits kept on the object are the level labels. The y limits use the same 7 percent pad as a scatter plot.
origin.value: The factor codes, the response, and the padded y limits.
origin.example:
b <- bwplot(mpg ~ factor(cyl), data = mtcars)
cat(b$y.limits, "\n")
